confirm.title: Call a blow-out?
confirm.lead: This cancels {tripTitle} and sends every booked diver one message: what happened, where their money stands, and the upcoming departures they already qualify for, as booking links.
confirm.moneyNote: Card payments go back automatically. Anything taken at the counter, or on a card DiveDay can’t reach, stays with you to return, and those divers are told a refund is owed.
confirm.diversHeading: {count, plural, one {# diver will be messaged} other {# divers will be messaged}}
confirm.noEmail: No email — flagged for a call
confirm.noDivers: Nobody is booked on this departure. Calling it cancels the trip.
confirm.departed: This departure is underway or has left, so there is nothing to blow out.

record.title: Blow-out cascade
record.rebookedDetail: hold a seat on another departure
record.unresolvedDetail: no new seat yet, so the blow-out isn’t over
record.noOffers: No qualifying dates, so the schedule was sent instead
record.empty: No divers were booked when the blow-out was called.

notices.called: Blow-out called. The trip is canceled and every diver’s message is on its way.
notices.departed: This departure is underway or has left, so nothing was canceled.
notices.dayCalled: {count, plural, one {Blow-out called. The departure is canceled and every diver’s message is on its way.} other {Blow-out called on # departures. They are canceled and every diver’s message is on its way.}}
notices.dayPartly: {called, plural, one {# departure called.} other {# departures called.}} {skipped, plural, one {# couldn’t be called: already left or no longer scheduled.} other {# couldn’t be called: already left or no longer scheduled.}}
notices.dayNone: Select at least one departure to call.

day.title: Call a blow-out for the day?
day.lead: This cancels every departure you select and sends each booked diver one message, the same as calling each one on its own. Nobody is offered another departure this call cancels, and the crew of each one hear at once.
day.booked: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody booked} one {# booked} other {# booked}}
day.nothingToCall: Nothing left to call on this day.
day.instead: Calling the whole day? Call several departures at once
day.confirmButton: {departures, plural, one {Cancel # departure} other {Cancel # departures}}, {divers, plural, one {# diver} other {# divers}}
